data.animaCaption: On the left, Ayachi Nene examines a film negative in a white lab coat, vest, and gold-rimmed glasses under red safelight; on the right, Shiki Natsume leans across the briefing table in a charcoal waistcoat and unbuttoned wine silk shirt under cyan monitor light behind a marked glass dossier board.
data.promptProse: A wide cinematic spy-thriller still inside an underground intelligence briefing room split cleanly by red darkroom light on the left and cool cyan terminal glow on the right. On the left, Ayachi Nene wears an unbuttoned white lab coat over a fitted dark grey vest, black tie, and thin gold-rimmed glasses as she inspects a film strip with focused sharpness; on the right, Shiki Natsume leans forward over the dossier table in a tailored charcoal waistcoat, unbuttoned wine-red silk shirt, and loosened necktie with cool commanding presence. Across the clear glass briefing board in the upper left foreground glows a crisp stamped warning label at the top left that reads "TOP SECRET" beside a smaller tactical screen caption at the bottom right that reads "CASE 044".
data.story: 红蓝双光切开地下情报室的暗影：左侧戴着细框眼镜的宁宁举起刚显影的底片，右侧解开酒红真丝领口的夏目撑桌俯身审视档案，前景玻璃白板上冷亮的机密印记将谍战氛围推到顶点。
